scope_summary.value: Design-build replacement of existing boiler plants in three buildings (B2641, B2865, B101A) at NAS Patuxent River, MD. Scope includes removal of existing boilers and associated equipment, installation of new high-efficiency hot water boilers, replacement of pumps and piping, controls integration with existing DDC systems, electrical power modifications, and potential asbestos abatement in Building 101A. Buildings remain occupied during construction; temporary heating service required. Three separate CLINs correspond to the three buildings.
scope_summary.source: BOD §Scope of Work and RFP Part 3 §1.0 Project Description
scope_summary.quote: Remove existing fuel oil boilers, pumps, and all associated equipment, provide, and install new high efficiency boilers, pumps, and all associated equipment to building 2641.

corroboration.claim: Boiler replacement in B2641, B2865, B101A with new high efficiency boilers
CLIN 0001-0003 describe identical scope per building

value.description: Occupied building. Existing: two Smith 19A-51W-03 cast iron fuel oil boilers, each 810 MBH. New: oil-fired packaged non-condensing boiler with flexible tubes, minimum 2 boilers each at 67% load. Requires crane for boiler removal/replacement. Control system tied to existing DDC system.
value.quote: The existing boilers are two Smith 19A-51W-03 (cast iron).

value.description: Occupied building. Existing: Fulton Gas-Fired Pulse Combustion Boiler, Model PHw-1000 (1,000,000 Btu/hr). New: 2 gas-fired cast iron modular condensing boilers, 650 MBH each, minimum 92.7% efficiency. Permit to Construct (PTC) required from Maryland MDE. Control system tied to existing DDC.
value.quote: The existing boiler is a Fulton™ Gas-Fired Pulse Combustion Boiler, Model PHw-1000.

value.description: Boiler room serving Hangar 101 (H101). Building not occupied during renovation but H101 is. Located adjacent to taxiway; FOD protocols required. Existing: two Hurst 4.2-MMBH gas-fired boilers (Title V permit), hot water pumps, steam converter. Boiler type clarified in BOD as two Weil McLain BGL-988-SF-PF-LO-UL. New: 2 high-efficiency gas-fired condensing hot water boilers. Asbestos abatement may be required; testing required. Roll-up door for access. PTC required from Maryland MDE.
value.source: BOD §Mechanical Design, RFP Part 3 CLIN 0003, RFP §Air Quality notes
value.quote: The existing boilers are two Weil McLain BGL-988-SF-PF-LO-UL.

design.notes: Design-build contract; design and construction are combined. BOD is dated August 13, 2020 (final level submittal), suggesting design was complete or near-complete at that point. RFP finalized 1/16/2020.

gross_square_footage.source: No drawing set present; no square footage stated in BOD or RFP

hvac: B2641: New oil-fired packaged non-condensing hot water boilers (2 minimum, each 67% of load); replacement pumps; new control system tied to existing DDC; shot-type chemical feeder
B2865: 2 new gas-fired cast iron modular condensing boilers, 650 MBH each, min 92.7% efficiency; new pumps; control system tied to existing DDC
B101A: 2 new high-efficiency gas-fired condensing hot water boilers; replacement of all associated equipment including pumps, steam converter, piping; new control panel
electrical: Modifications to existing 480Y/277V or 208Y/120V 3-phase electrical distribution to support new mechanical equipment
Individual motor starters with separate disconnect switches for each motor
New conduit (IMC/rigid metallic) and copper THHN/THWN conductors
plumbing: Dam installation around floor drains in B2641 for fuel leak/contamination prevention
Domestic water insulation on hot supply and recirculation piping
Replacement of air separator, make-up water assembly, and expansion tank in each building

drawings.extraction_notes: No drawing-set PDF was present in the intake directory. The RFP Part 6 attachments include embedded photographs and labeled room-layout sketches for each building, but these are rasterized within the PDF and do not constitute engineering drawing sheets. Consequently no per-sheet drawing inventory could be produced. MEP system inventory above is derived entirely from text sources (BOD and RFP Part 3/6).

conflict_flags.rationale: The BOD is BFA's design document and is more likely to reflect verified field conditions. The RFP Air Quality note references 'Hurst 4.2-MMBH gas-fired units' as the equipment included in the NAX PAX Title V Operating Permit, while the BOD text (authored by BFA after field investigation) identifies Weil McLain units. Possible explanation: Hurst may refer to the original/older boilers under the air permit, while Weil McLain are what BFA found installed at time of design. Both values are retained in building_descriptions; conflict flagged for human verification.
conflict_flags.notes: This discrepancy may indicate a prior replacement occurred between permit issuance and BFA's field investigation, or the RFP and BOD reference different equipment in the same space.
